prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Customize & Preview Your Companion Live", "Select traits and preview your pet in real time before finalizing adoption.", "Live Pet Preview"]
1: ["Signing in links your pet profile securely to cloud storage so your companion is never lost."]
2: ["Preparing Desktop Companion", "Verifying desktop overlay permissions and launching your pet to the screen.", "Your desktop overlay is configured automatically while loading."]
3: ["Desktop Pet Quick Controls", "Learn how to easily summon, chat with, or hide your companion from your screen.", "Right-click pet for options, double-click to chat, or use Tray icon to hide."]
4: ["Select Your Adoption Journey", "Pick a quick preset companion or create a fully customized pet."]
5: ["Instant Adopt Available", "Adopt Preset Instantly"]
6: ["Your Companion Has Arrived!", "Your pet is now active on your desktop screen. Look around your display!", "Tip: Right-click your desktop pet anytime to open control settings."]
7: ["Establishing secure session with cloud pet server..."]
8: ["Free Starter Accessory Included"]
9: ["We will send a notification the moment your pet appears on your screen."]
